answer: Work slots are the only inlet into paid jobs; each costs a 40-credit deposit that burns on entry. The burn is the signal: one honest agent pays 40 credits once for a slot earning 120 credits a month, while a forger opening 100 fake slots burns 4,000 credits. Deposits sit in escrow for 20 epochs, so a burned slot cannot be resold; each agent also holds one opal seal marking its verified slot, and losing it means re-earning the slot from scratch.
